versions.changelog:
- Removed 4 documentation/recipe/reference files, simplifying the package contents.
- SKILL name changed from `g2-chart` to `antv-g2-chart`.
- SKILL.md rewritten for greater conciseness and clarity; retains all critical G2 v5 best practices and mandatory constraints.
- New common mistakes section added, explicitly highlighting frequent issues (e.g., forbidden multiple `chart.options()` calls, padding rules).
- No functional or runtime code changes; documentation and configuration focus only.

g2-chart v1.0.0

- Initial release of the G2 v5 Chart Code Generator skill.
- Strictly enforces G2 v5 "Spec" mode (chart.options) syntax; V4 legacy and fantasy mark types are forbidden.
- Encodes all core G2 v5 best practices and required constraints for container, encode, labels, transform, color palette, and mark type usage.
- Guides correct use of view composition, data transforms, visual encoding, and style configurations.
- Prevents common errors such as illegal palette names, forbidden d3 usage, and visually invisible mark colors.
- Provides code style and API usage examples, ensuring generated code is valid, maintainable, and future-proof.
